start: Settings, How the app picks your next weight; Weight step is Standard

user_sees: Rows "Small" (About 2.5% more each time), "Standard" with "Recommended" and a tick, "Large" (About 10% more each time)

must_not: The sheet staying open with the old tick
The next weight suggestion still using Standard

start: Settings, Rest timer and sounds; Rest-over sound is MettleUp chime

user_sees: Sheet "Rest-over sound" with "The sound when your rest is over. The MettleUp chime is the default."
Rows MettleUp chime (Recommended), Bell, Double beep, Whistle
must_not: A missing sound from the four

user_sees: The sheet stays open with Bell ticked
must_not: The sheet closing before the sound can be compared

start: Settings, Plates and bars; Machine and cable steps is Automatic

steps.action: Tap the machine steps row, tap "5 kg"
user_sees: The sheet closes, the row says 5 kg
must_not: Suggested machine weights not in 5 kg steps afterwards

start: Settings, How the app picks your next weight; Reps to aim for is Match my goal

user_sees: Rows Match my goal (Recommended), Strength, Muscle, Higher reps, each with one line
The sheet closes, the row says Strength
must_not: Rep ranges inside routines changed without the footnote saying so

start: Weight step sheet open, Standard ticked

must_not: A change saved or the value reset

steps.action: Open the sheet and close it by swiping down

must_not: A saved value the app does not know falling back silently to another choice
